title: MonthPicker configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.MonthPickerAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AllowInput.description: Stores the ability to allow inputs to be editable or not

DateFormat.description: Display format of the selected month (e.g. MM/YYYY).

DisableMobile.description: Stores the ability to disable the mobile flatpickr behavior. False is the default provider option

InitialMonth.description: Month selected when the picker is built ({ Month, Year }). (source type: MonthYear)

MaxMonth.description: Latest selectable month ({ Month, Year }). (source type: MonthYear)

MinMonth.description: Earliest selectable month ({ Month, Year }). (source type: MonthYear)

ServerDateFormat.description: Store the Server Date format that will be used to casting the selected dates into a knowned date by/for Flatpickr

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
